title: 第八章 铁声
content_zh:
黑铁磨石的发现，像一颗小石子投入陈默死水般的日常，漾开一圈几乎微不可察的涟漪。

    柴刀被它修整得愈发锋利，砍柴时省下的力气，被他转化为更精准的挥砍角度，或者，是更早一刻完成定额后，那多出来的、可以喘口气的片刻宁静。夜里打磨黑铁磨石本身，也成了新的、耗费气力却令人心安的功课。那块脸盆大的粗糙铁砧，在他持续的刮擦研磨下，平整面日益光滑，边缘也被他刻意磨出了几处便于抓握的凹陷。两者撞击、摩擦时发出的“嘎吱”声，从最初的艰涩刺耳，渐渐变得沉闷短促，仿佛两块沉默的骨骼在黑暗里较劲、磨合。

    那本体术残篇，他依旧在缓慢推进。第一式维持的时间，艰难地爬升到接近二十息。他开始尝试第二式，那是一个需要身体如弓般反曲、四肢着地的怪异姿势，对腰腹和脊背的力量与柔韧性要求极高。第一次尝试，他只坚持了两息不到，就瘫倒在地，腰背仿佛断了一般，半晌动弹不得。他没有气馁，只是每晚增加一点点尝试的时间，忍受着筋骨被强行拉伸扭曲的剧痛。配合着微量、谨慎的铁骨草汁液，那深入骨髓的酸痛，似乎真的在转化为一丝丝微不可察的力量，沉淀进他瘦削的骨骼和紧实的肌肉里。

    炼气吐纳依旧是他最大的心病。胸口那堵墙顽固地矗立着，任凭那缕暖流如何冲击、盘旋，也难有寸进。他尝试过按照笔记上关于“静心”的暗示，将阴干的雾灵菇放在鼻端，试图借助那微弱的清凉气息宁定心神，效果却微乎其微。他甚至冒险，将那几块青礞石在溪水中反复淘洗，晒干后，用柴刀背耐心砸成尽可能细的粉末，然后用一块干净的布包起一小撮，在吐纳时握在掌心，据说某些低阶“静心符”会掺入此物。结果同样令人失望，或许是他的“静心”不得法，或许是这青礞石品质太次、杂质太多，除了让手心沾上一层洗不净的青灰色，别无他感。

    他依旧每日记录。日课纸背面，炭笔的字迹越来越密，也越来越枯燥：

    “四月初十，晴。铁砧面磨平三指宽。体术第二式，可维持四息。吐纳，气阻膻中三十八息，退。尝试礞石粉，掌心微凉，于气感无益。”

    “四月十二，阴。柴刀刃口有小崩，以黑铁石修复合用。铁骨草汁液一株量，胃部微灼，半时辰方平。吐纳，暖流较昨日活跃一线，然瓶颈如故。”

    进步，缓慢得如同石上攀附的苔藓，非经年累月，难以察觉其生长。而时间的流逝，却不会为此稍停。外门小比的日子，就在这种近乎凝滞的重复中，一天天逼近了。

    四月中，一场突如其来的倒春寒席卷了青云山脉。前几日还暖意融融，一夜北风过后，清晨醒来，屋檐下竟挂了薄薄一层冰凌。山道湿滑处结了暗冰，好几个杂役清早上山时摔了跤，虽无大碍，却也鼻青脸肿，龇牙咧嘴。

    陈默寅时三刻起身时，只觉得寒气如针，穿透单薄的衣衫，直刺骨髓。他咬着牙，用比往日更冰的井水擦身，激得浑身皮肤瞬间绷紧，泛起一层鸡皮疙瘩。站桩时，双腿的颤抖来得比往日更早、更剧烈，牙齿不受控制地轻轻打颤。但他依旧稳稳地定在那里，努力将呼吸拉长、放缓，与侵入身体的寒意对抗，也与体内那缕似乎也被冻得更加凝滞的暖流相互呼应。

    早上的柴，因结冰而更难砍伐，柴刀砍在冻硬的木头上，震得虎口发麻。他不得不更频繁地用黑铁磨石修整刃口。一上午的劳作下来，手掌被粗糙的工具和寒气割出数道细小的裂口，渗着血丝，又被冻得麻木。

    午后，他被派去修缮杂役院东北角一段被冻裂的水渠。和他一起的是王虎和李大。水渠是泥土夯成，冻裂的口子不小，需要挖开破损处，重新和泥修补。泥土冻得硬邦邦的，一镐下去，只留下个白点，震得手臂发酸。三人轮流挥镐，忙活了近一个时辰，才将破损处的冻土清理干净。

    “这鬼天气！”李大啐了一口，搓着冻得通红的手，“小比可别赶上这种天，不然别说比试，站那儿就得冻僵。”

    王虎闷头铲着碎土，闻言只是低低叹了口气。

    陈默没接话，他正用铁锹将和好的湿泥填入缺口。湿泥冰冷刺骨，沾在手上，很快带走更多热量，手指几乎失去知觉。他不得不时时停下来，将手放在嘴边哈几口热气，揉搓一下，再继续。

    渠边有棵老槐树，枝桠光秃秃的，在寒风里瑟缩。树下一个穿着粗布棉袄、袖口磨得发亮的老杂役，正佝偻着背，用一把缺口更甚的斧头，费力地劈着一段不知从哪搬来的粗大树根。斧头很钝，老杂役力气也小，一斧下去，树根上只留下浅浅一道印子。他喘口气，又举起斧头，动作缓慢而执着。

    是周老头。陈默认了出来。他好像总是独自一人，干着最吃力、最没人愿意干的活计。

    寒风卷起地上的尘土和碎叶，打着旋扑过来。周老头被迷了眼，咳嗽了几声，动作顿了顿，用袖子擦了擦眼睛，又举起斧头。

    “笃！”又是一声闷响，斧头砍进去一点，却被木头的纹理夹住，拔不出来了。老头用力拽了两下，斧头纹丝不动。他喘得更厉害了，枯瘦的身子微微摇晃。

    陈默放下铁锹，走了过去。

    “周老伯，”他开口道，“我帮您。”

    周老头抬起头，浑浊的眼睛看了陈默一眼，没说话，只是松开了握着斧柄的手，退开一步，又咳嗽起来。

    陈默握住斧柄，入手冰凉沉重。他试了试角度，发现斧刃确实被木头死死咬住了。他没有硬拔，而是双手握柄，身体微沉，腰腹发力，先顺着卡住的方向微微一压，再猛地向斜上方一抬——
content_en:
The discovery of the black iron grindstone was like a pebble thrown into Chen Mo's stagnant daily life, causing almost imperceptible ripples.
The hatchet was sharpened by it, and the energy he saved when chopping wood was transformed into a more precise cutting angle, or the extra moment of peace that allowed him to take a breath after completing the quota earlier.Polishing the black iron whetstone itself at night has become a new, labor-intensive but reassuring task.Under his continuous scraping and grinding, the rough anvil, which was as big as a washbasin, became smoother and smoother, and he also deliberately made several depressions on the edge for easy gripping.The "crunching" sound made when the two collided and rubbed, from the initial harsh and harsh sound, gradually became dull and short, as if two silent bones were competing and grinding together in the dark.
He was still advancing slowly on the remaining parts of the body technique.The duration of the first posture climbed hard to nearly twenty breaths.He began to try the second posture, which was a weird posture that required the body to recurve like a bow and land on all fours. It required extremely high strength and flexibility in the waist, abdomen and back.The first time he tried, he could only hold on for less than two breaths before he collapsed to the ground, his back seemed to be broken, and he couldn't move for a long time.He was not discouraged, he just tried a little longer every night and endured the severe pain of his muscles and bones being forcibly stretched and twisted.Coupled with a small amount of careful Iron Bone Grass juice, the pain that penetrated into the bone marrow seemed to be really transforming into a trace of undetectable strength, settling into his thin bones and tight muscles.
Refining Qi and breathing is still his biggest worry.The wall on my chest stood stubbornly, no matter how the warm current hit and swirled, it was difficult to make any progress.He tried following the hints about "meditation" in his notes and put the dried Mist Mushroom on his nose, trying to calm his mind with the faint cool breath, but the effect was minimal.He even took the risk and repeatedly washed the few pieces of bluestone in the stream, dried them, and then patiently smashed them into the finest powder possible with the back of a hatchet. Then he wrapped a small handful in a clean cloth and held it in the palm of his hand when spitting it out. It is said that some low-level "meditation charms" will be mixed with this substance.The result was equally disappointing. Perhaps his "meditation" was not done right, or perhaps the quality of the Qingmao stone was too low and contained too many impurities. There was no other feeling except that the palm of the hand was stained with a layer of blue-gray color that could not be washed away.
He still records every day.On the back of the daily class paper, the charcoal writing is getting denser and denser, and also getting boring:
"On the tenth day of April, it's sunny. The surface of the anvil is flattened to a width of three fingers. The second posture of physical skills can maintain four breaths. Breathing in and out, the breath is blocked for thirty-eight breaths, and it retreats. Try the stone powder, the palm is slightly cool, and it is not helpful for the sense of breath."
"April 12, overcast. There is a small chip on the blade of the hatchet, which can be repaired with black iron stone. A dose of iron bone grass juice will cause a slight burning in the stomach, and it will be flat after half an hour. After vomiting, the warm current is slightly more active than yesterday, but the bottleneck remains the same."
Progress is as slow as moss clinging to a stone. It is difficult to notice its growth unless it takes place over many years.The passage of time will not stop for this.Xiaobi's days as an outsider are approaching day by day in this almost stagnant repetition.
In mid-April, a sudden late-spring cold swept across the Qingyun Mountains.It was warm and cozy a few days ago, but after a night of north wind, when I woke up in the morning, there was a thin layer of ice hanging under the eaves.The slippery parts of the mountain road were covered with dark ice. Several handymen fell down while going up the mountain in the morning. Although they were not seriously injured, their noses were bruised and their faces were swollen, and their teeth were grimacing.
When Chen Moyin stood up at three o'clock, he felt the cold air was like needles, penetrating through his thin clothes and piercing his bone marrow.He gritted his teeth and wiped his body with well water that was colder than usual, causing the skin all over his body to tighten instantly and create a layer of goosebumps.While standing, my legs trembled earlier and more violently than usual, and my teeth chattered uncontrollably.But he still stayed there steadily, trying to lengthen and slow down his breathing, fighting against the coldness that invaded his body, and echoing the warm current in his body that seemed to be frozen even more.
The firewood in the morning was more difficult to cut because of the ice. The hatchet struck the frozen wood, causing the tiger's mouth to feel numb.He had to sharpen the edge more frequently with a black iron whetstone.After a whole morning's work, there were several small cracks in the palms cut by rough tools and the cold air, oozing with blood, and numbed by the cold.
In the afternoon, he was sent to repair a section of the frozen canal in the northeast corner of the courtyard.With him were Wang Hu and Li Da.The ditch is made of rammed earth, and the cracks are quite cracked by the frost. The damaged areas need to be dug out and repaired with new mud.The soil was so frozen that when the pickaxe was dropped, only a white spot was left, which made the arm ache from the shock.The three of them took turns swinging their pickaxes and worked for nearly an hour before cleaning up the frozen soil in the damaged areas.
"What a damn weather!" Li Da spat, rubbing his hands that were red from the cold, "Little Bi, please don't get caught up in weather like this, otherwise you'll freeze standing there, let alone a competition."
Wang Hu shoveled the broken soil with his head down, and just sighed softly after hearing this.
Chen Mo didn't answer. He was filling the gap with the reconciled wet mud with a shovel.The wet mud was biting and cold, and when it stuck to my hands, it quickly took away more heat, and my fingers almost lost all feeling.He had to stop from time to time, put his hand to his mouth, take a few breaths of hot air, rub it, and then continue.
There is an old locust tree beside the canal, with bare branches, shrinking in the cold wind.Under the tree, an old handyman wearing a coarse cotton-padded jacket with shiny cuffs was hunched over, using an ax with an even wider gap to chop at a thick tree root that he didn't know where he had moved.The ax head was very dull and the old handyman was weak. When the ax fell, only a shallow mark was left on the root of the tree.He took a breath and raised the ax again, slowly and persistently.
It's Old Man Zhou.Chen acquiesced.He always seemed to be alone, doing the most difficult work that no one wanted to do.
The cold wind picked up the dust and broken leaves on the ground and swirled towards them.Old man Zhou was stunned, coughed a few times, paused, wiped his eyes with his sleeve, and raised the ax again.
"Tuk!" There was another muffled sound. The ax penetrated a little, but was caught in the grain of the wood and could not be pulled out.The old man pulled hard twice, but the ax didn't move at all.He panted harder, and his skinny body swayed slightly.
Chen Mo put down his shovel and walked over.
"Uncle Zhou," he said, "let me help you."
Old Zhou raised his head and glanced at Chen Mo with his cloudy eyes. He didn't say anything. He just let go of the hand holding the ax handle, took a step back, and started coughing again.
Chen Mo held the ax handle, his hand cold and heavy.He tried the angle and found that the ax blade was indeed bitten tightly by the wood.He did not pull it out by force, but held the handle with both hands, his body sank slightly, and he exerted force on his waist and abdomen. He first pressed slightly in the direction of the jam, and then suddenly lifted it diagonally upward——
